name: Pinarello
note: Italian bike brand; Netcompany INEOS's bike partner, its mark on the chest, upper back and shorts of the 2026 kit. L Catterton announced it sold Pinarello to a private family office in June 2023 (claim pinarello-ownership); the company release does not name the buyer, so the real owner is not identified. Cycling trade press (Cyclingnews) reported the buyer is linked to businessman Ivan Glasenberg. No human-rights finding against the company found. Left unrated until the owner is identified.
